screenshots.name: 01-posted-open
screenshots.caption: Posting 18:30–20:30 creates an open request, uses the field timezone without extra database columns, and does not accept it.

screenshots.name: 02-multiple-requests
screenshots.caption: The same team can post a second request immediately next to the first one.

screenshots.name: 03-overlap-blocked
screenshots.caption: An overlapping request is rejected without changing the existing requests.

screenshots.name: 04-fresh-invitation
screenshots.caption: The freshly posted request link remains available and offers login or registration.

screenshots.name: 05-waiting-for-acceptance
screenshots.caption: The other team must explicitly accept; opening the link and signing in do not confirm a match.

screenshots.name: 06-explicitly-accepted
screenshots.caption: Only the opposing team's explicit acceptance confirms the match.
